summary: Fixed IVX Android home module black screen by rewriting HomeScreen as a real Command Center dashboard, adding bottom navigation, disabling dynamic color in favor of explicit IVX dark scheme, setting window background to IVXDark, forcing dark system bars, making HomeViewModel resilient to backend 404s, and adding backend aliases for /api/ivx/deals, /api/ivx/properties, /api/ivx/investor-crm. Release APK built successfully and production API endpoints verified.
rootCauses: HomeScreen.kt was a placeholder with no real content or background color
AppTheme used dynamic color which can render black on some Samsung devices
MainActivity enabled edge-to-edge without setting a window background or handling system bar appearance
No bottom navigation existed; startDestination was autonomous_dashboard

fixes.change: Disabled dynamic color and defined explicit IVX dark color scheme with background/surface colors
Set window decor background to IVXDark and forced dark status/navigation bar appearance
Added bottom navigation bar with Home, Autonomous, Chat, Profile tabs; Home is start destination
Rewrote as full IVX Command Center dashboard with status banner, quick stats, and navigation grids
New ViewModel aggregating health, agents, deals, properties, investors, and version data; resilient to 404s
Registered HomeViewModel in Koin DI module
Set Scaffold containerColor to IVXDark for consistent background
Added /api/ivx/deals, /api/ivx/properties, /api/ivx/investor-crm routes for Android home dashboard
